      Parameters:
      voDataIndex - sets the opportunity increment
      voDataPk - sets the opportunity PK / primary key
      orgName - sets the name to the opportunity
      userDataIndex - sets the user increment linked to the volunteer opportunity

      coordinateLocation - sets the coordinates of the opportunity

      contactInfo - sets the contact info of the opportunity
      locationNotes - sets the location notes of the opportunity
      permanent - sets the permanent value of the opportunity
